story_overview: Julian, a man with a gaunt face, investigates mysteries originating in his gothic study. His search takes him to a dusty attic where he uncovers strange objects like a dead raven and a skull, aided by the enigmatic Alex. Julian also interacts with Marco, a man with a tattooed hand, over a mysterious painting and a box of old papers.

video_prompts:
Julian: Man with a gaunt face, prominent cheekbones, intense dark eyes, and slightly disheveled dark wavy hair, wearing a fitted black waistcoat over a white collared shirt with the top button undone and sleeves rolled to his forearms.
The Gothic Study: An ornate study/library with bookshelves, a mantelpiece, an ornate mirror, and ornate, skeletal candle holders containing red candles.
the ornate writing desk: Large, ornate writing desk made of dark polished wood, featuring carved legs and drawers with brass pulls.
the blank leather-bound book: Thick, large, hardbound book with a plain dark leather cover and blank pages.
the black fountain pen: Fountain pen with a glossy black body, a gold-colored clip and band, and a fine gold nib.
the green banker's lamp: Classic banker's lamp with a polished brass base and a curved, emerald green glass shade illuminated from within.
the skeletal candle holders: Tall, lit red candles in ornate, skeletal holders.

In the dimly lit The Gothic Study, Julian, wearing the white shirt and black vest, sits at the ornate writing desk. He leans forward under the green glow of the green banker's lamp, writing in the blank leather-bound book with the black fountain pen. After a moment, he pauses and looks thoughtfully down at the page while the skeletal candle holders flicker softly in the foreground.

Marco: Man with a tattooed hand.
Close-up on Marco's hand as it slides open a drawer of the ornate writing desk. The hand lifts the photograph of the woman in red out of the drawer and holds it up.

the dark green mug: Dark green ceramic mug with a glossy finish and a simple C-shaped handle.
the floor-to-ceiling bookshelves: Ornate, floor-to-ceiling dark wood bookshelves with decorative molding, filled with densely packed rows of hardcover and leather-bound books in various colors.

In The Gothic Study, Julian, wearing the white shirt and black vest, stands beside the ornate writing desk, on which sits the illuminated green banker's lamp and the black fountain pen. He picks up the dark green mug from the desk, turns, and walks towards the floor-to-ceiling bookshelves in the background.
